author: Kushal
problem: Count how many loads in a list are at least 90 percent of a given capacity.
bug_description: Uses > instead of >=, so a load exactly at 90 percent of capacity is not counted as near-capacity.

comments.accurate: Counts loads that reach at least 90 percent of capacity
comments.wrong_behavior: Counts loads that exceed 90 percent of capacity, so a load exactly at the threshold is left out
comments.wrong_location: Threshold math confirmed; double-check how zero-load entries move through the loop
